name: Sweat Baths in Heated Huts
prompt:
Create ONE Tomorrow and Tomorrow research painting. Reference supplies ONLY field medium/palette and EXACT EXTRA-WIDE canvas. Preserve its width and aspect, full bleed, no frame/text/grid/3:2 output. NEW SUBJECT: Outside a small low hide-covered branch shelter, two fully clothed adults prepare a few warmed stones with wooden tongs beside a simple hearth and a small clay water bowl; faint steam seen at partly open doorway. Sage/celadon ink-watercolor on cream. Keep all figures covered in hides. No nudity, metal stove, chimney, tiled bath, bucket technology or medical efficacy claim.
CRITICAL composition: complete main heads, hands, working mechanism all within central y170..590 on a 765px-high banner; zoom out to fit actual 3.37:1 research card crop. Background only above and below that band. Game years23–25: hides, cordage, baskets, early pottery, modest earthen huts; plain weaving comes later. Do not borrow later reference technology.
review: Approved after full-canvas and actual 3.37:1 private GPU card review; complete heads and practical mechanism retained. Clean import, headless/GPU PASS14.
